source_snapshot.procedure: Enable BIOS Mirror mode, check BIOS/OS size and stress over2h.
source_snapshot.criteria: Available equals installed; DC/warm reboot and stress have no errors.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires direct BIOS evidence, mirror capacity equation, separate transitions and full two-hour stress.

old_problem: The generic available-equals-installed wording contradicts mirrored redundancy, and criteria-only DC/warm phases lacked a state matrix.
disposition_reason: Mirror mode, two-hour stress and required DC/warm transitions are explicit. The platform-specific installed/protected/usable equation and BIOS label are runtime project configuration; they can be bound fail closed rather than leave the review Pending. ED-06 keeps transitions distinct and ED-11 restricts BIOS changes.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row41 all18 XLSX cells and history2655.
Preserved direct BIOS Mirror proof, redundant-capacity semantics, separate DC/warm coverage and full two-hour stress.
Rejected EDAC or keyword logs as standalone proof; no BIOS, power or stress action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized Memory Mirror capacity, transition and two-hour stress validation
test_case.purpose: Verify approved Memory Mirror mode is active, provides the expected protected and usable capacity, persists across DC/warm transitions and remains healthy under two-hour stress.
required_package: Approved board/BIOS revision and exact Mirror label/value/evidence
DIMM/rank/channel placement and installed/protected/reserved/BIOS/OS usable capacity equation/tolerance
Qualified operator/KVM and known-good BIOS restore plan
Separate DC-cycle and warm-reboot counts/order with OFF-to-OS-ready definition
Approved two-hour stress tool/profile plus ECC/OOM/thermal/power/watchdog limits
test_case.test_command: Capture baseline BIOS setting/topology/capacity; operator enables only the approved Mirror value. Record visual BIOS mode and capacity, full DMI/NUMA/OS/EDAC evidence, then perform each approved DC cycle and warm reboot separately through OS Ready with per-phase health capture. Run the approved two-hour memory stress once with continuous monitoring and restore the recorded setting when required.
test_case.expected_result: Mirror mode remains directly evidenced; installed, protected and usable capacities satisfy the approved equation after every transition; the full stress completes without new ECC/SEL/platform error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires direct BIOS mode proof, platform-approved mirror capacity equation, separate DC/warm results and complete two-hour stress evidence. Available-equals-installed or EDAC keywords alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Only the approved Mirror field may change; record known-good baseline/recovery.
Operator owns BIOS, DC and warm operations; no automated cycle or retry.
Verify each DC OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready state separately from warm reboot.
Abort on no-POST, unexpected capacity/topology, ECC/SEL/OOM/thermal/power/watchdog fault.
expected_evidence: Before/after BIOS Mirror screenshots and platform/DIMM identity
Separate DC and warm transition timelines through OS Ready
test_case.recovery: On no-POST, unexpected usable capacity or mirror/ECC fault, stop later phases, preserve KVM/POST/SEL/ECC/topology evidence, have the operator restore only the recorded known-good memory mode, and require memory/BIOS owner review before another transition.

source_conflict.reason: The ambiguous capacity phrase is replaced by a mandatory platform mirror equation without discarding Mirror, transition or stress coverage.

blocked.reason: Review is complete; platform equation and state-matrix parameters gate execution.
